entities.name: Clan Exogamy Rules
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Nearly all early societies developed rules requiring marriage outside one's own clan or kinship group (exogamy). These rules prevented inbreeding and forced alliances between groups. Violating exogamy taboos carried severe punishment — sometimes death.
